Idar, Hindovar, Davad

Krishnadas Maharaj's ancestors came from some village in Gujarat and settled in Idar. When Muslim rule was established there, Krishnadas went to live with his maternal relatives in Hindaver. When he met Naranadas at Puniyad, he told him that he was a resident of Davad; so it is said he used to live in Davad. Thus Idar, Hindovar, and Davad are punya sthali (places of religious merit) associated with the name of Krishnadas.
